{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders — only 'completed' should be in the population
population = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = population.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute difference
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print results
print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
